changelog: **Shared mentorship routes on the permission layer (#1571, story #1565):** the pairing, stage-history, cohort, interaction, relation-note, relation-health, re-engagement, to-do, project-task, project, note-convert and journey routes no longer compare the caller's role to `'ADMIN'`. Pure admin gates use `requirePermission()` (`/api/cohorts*` → `program.read` / `program.write`, `/api/status-changes*` → `pipeline.transition`, `POST /api/mentorship` and `/transfer` → `relation.write`); admin-or-mentor gates use `requireRoleOrPermission(['MENTOR'], …)` (lifecycle, skills, AI draft / next step, interaction summary, relation notes, relation health → `analytics.read`, re-engagement → `user.read` / `user.write`, the shared to-do pool → `content.read`); and the "admins see the whole org" branches ask `can()` (`program.read` for reads, `relation.write` / `program.write` for writes). The weekly-report PATCH refusal of admins stays as an `allowed` baseline entry — it narrows access. A signed-in caller of a role these routes never admitted gets 403 instead of 401.
